data_fields.name: weapon_fire_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: Firedelay ms x tick speed / 1000 (weapon data table not read)

best_idea: A fire button is a counter of state flips rather than a boolean, so presses that land between two network sends are all counted on the server, and a shot is due whenever a new press is pending and the gun is ready.
decision_why: Keep the press counter and the server-side count, and fix the donor gap that drops a press during reload by holding the previous state until a shot is considered. Keep the aim offset clamp as the virtual-stick model for thumb aim. Put it in src/fight/intake.ts so the engine counts and the server verifies every shot.
acceptance: A server test asserts that two taps, the second during a 300 ms reload, produce two shots (the second when the reload ends) and that one tap at a ready gun produces exactly one shot; on a 375-wide phone the aim thumb offset stays inside the clamp circle.
